messages:
ops-bot: Planned maintenance window starting in 30m for serving cluster eu-west1. Expected impact: 5–10m rolling drain per pool for kernel rollout. Notifying oncall and posting to #status. Please ack if you see any regressions.
Sam (oncall): Ack. I'll be primary for the window. Notes: we'll pause drains if error rate exceeds 0.5% sustained for 5m.
Lee (eng-sre): Copy. Running drain script against low-traffic pools first. Command: ```./scripts/drain-nodes --pools=pool-eu-1 --max-concurrent=2``` Will monitor KV cache availability.
ops-bot: Drain job started on pool-eu-1 (nodes 12–13). Logs streaming to https://logs.redwood.ai/drains/1719876543
Lee (eng-sre): Observing small increase in tail latency on text-generation-v1 canary, +30ms. Not alarming yet.
Sam (oncall): Getting paged from paging-bot: ERROR spike on embeddings endpoint (embeddings-prod) from 12:52 -> 12:54. Alert id PGR-8821. Anyone seeing correlation with drain?
Lee (eng-sre): Checking. ```kubectl get pods -n inference -l app=embeddings -o wide``` shows 2 pods restarting in pool-eu-1. Investigating image/driver handoff.
Maria (support): Heads-up: two customers in EU region have opened high-priority tickets reporting 503s. Linking ticket ids: CS-4211, CS-4212.
Sam (oncall): Paging escalation — Jordan, Carmen FYI. We'll pause the next drain batch. Lee, can you roll back the kernel flags to previous profile?
Lee (eng-sre): Rolling back quant kernel patch on pool-eu-1 now: ```opsctl kernel rollback --cluster eu-west1 --profile stable-2026-02``` Will take ~2m per node. Pausing drain queue.
statusbot: Draft status page update prepared -> DRAFT: "Intermittent 503s for embeddings in eu-west1 during maintenance; mitigation in progress. No data loss. Updates every 15 mins." Approve to publish?
Jordan (product): Approve publish. Keep messaging: 'we're mitigating; some requests may see errors; full service expected within 1 hour'.
Carmen (customer-success): I'll send a proactive note to affected accounts with CS-4211/CS-4212 template. Draft: "We're performing a planned maintenance in EU region which has caused transient errors for embeddings. Engineers are mitigating; expected resolution within 1 hour. Contact support if you see persistent issues."
Maria (support): Sending draft to customers now. Using priority subject: "Action required: temporary disruption to embeddings (eu-west1) during maintenance"
Sam (oncall): Pager rotation — I'm handing primary to Lee for the next 30m while I coordinate CS comms. Lee, you're primary for mitigation. @oncall-handoff please record.
Lee (eng-sre): Acknowledged and on it. Node rollback progressing, 1/4 nodes rolled back, pod restarts stabilizing.
ops-bot: Rollback complete on nodes 12–13. Health checks passing.
Lee (eng-sre): Embeddings pod error rate dropped back under threshold (0.08%). Rolling resume of drain planned but will run at single concurrency.
Sam (oncall): Re-scheduling drain with reduced concurrency. Starting final batches now.
statusbot: Status page update published: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/embeddings-eu-maint-1719876543 - "Investigating" -> "Identified".
Carmen (customer-success): Customers notified. Two customers confirmed they received the email and will monitor. No requests for immediate assistance.
Maria (support): Closing CS-4211, CS-4212 as "mitigated" pending customer confirmation.
Lee (eng-sre): Final drain batch completed. Post-maint checks: kv cache hit ratio stable, tail latency baseline within 2ms.
Sam (oncall): Back on primary. Thanks Lee. Final status update to publish and customer follow-up please.
statusbot: Draft final status update: "Maintenance completed. All services returned to normal. If you continue to experience issues, contact support." Approving and publishing now.
ops-bot: Published status: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/embeddings-eu-maint-1719876543/resolved
Carmen (customer-success): Sent follow-up to affected customers with resolution note and compensation info where applicable.
Sam (oncall): Nice work. Postmortem flagging: did the kernel rollout require more conservative canary gating? Lee, please add notes to incident tracker PGR-8821.
Lee (eng-sre): Will write postmortem with timeline, metrics, and suggested gating changes (smaller canary batch, extended observation window).
Jordan (product): We'll also review customer comms cadence — maybe send SMS for high-availability customers in future windows.
Sam (oncall): Closing thread. Follow-up: schedule a retro tomorrow 10:00 for stakeholders. :thumbsup:
